lines.speaker: A
lines.pinyin: Xià ge yuè nǐ xiǎng zuò shénme?
lines.english: What do you want to do next month?

lines.speaker: B
lines.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng qù lǚyóu, qù Běijīng wán.
lines.english: I want to travel, go to Beijing for fun.

lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 和朋友一起去。你要去吗？
lines.pinyin: Hé péngyou yīqǐ qù. Nǐ yào qù ma?
lines.english: Going with friends. Do you want to go?

lines.speaker: A
lines.pinyin: Wǒ yě xiǎng qù, wèn wen wǒ péngyou.
lines.english: I also want to go, ask my friend.

lines.speaker: B
lines.pinyin: Hǎo, nà wǒmen xià ge yuè jiàn.
lines.english: Good, then we meet next month.
